newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba aims for group sales of Y8 trln in 2001/02.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba aims for group sales of Y8 trln in 2001/02.

text.p: Toshiba Corp on Thursday unveiled a five-year business plan under which the company will aim for group sales of eight trillion yen in the year to March 2002.
The major electrical appliance maker hopes to raise its group-based return on equity ratio to more than 10 percent in 2001/02 from the current 5.4 percent.
Toshiba will continue to increase production at its factories in Asia outside of Japan, a company spokesman said.
The company plans to increase the ratio of overseas sales to total group sales to 50 percent from the current 37 percent over the next five years.
The plan also provides for the total number of employees in the Toshiba group to rise to more than 200,000 from 186,000 as of the end of March 1997.

The company aims for a ratio of profits to total sales of more than 10 percent in its information and communication operations over the next five years, compared with three to five percent expected for the heavy electric machinery and home appliance business.
Toshiba also aims to reduce the group-based ratio of debt to annual earnings to less than 100 percent in 2001/02 from the current 154 percent.
